rows.task: Connect the two blue Cat5e cables from the old phone block to new keystone jacks, join them with a patch cord, then test the link

titles: Label and free the first blue cable
Label and free the second blue cable
Punch cable 1 into first keystone jack
Punch cable 2 into second keystone jack
Seat both jacks in coupler or surface-mount box
Connect the two jacks with a patch cord
Test the link with cable tester
